title: P0 live zero-scientific-approval admission smoke test
proposition: A PR changing only well-formed sandbox experiment files should be admission-eligible without independent scientific approval when exact required engineering checks pass.
falsifier: The live GitHub ruleset or stewardship check demands an unrelated scientific approval, or reports an erroneous success despite a protected-path mutation.

sources: Live ruleset #25371960 readback 2026-10-19: required sandbox-policy, sandbox-stewardship, saved-reference-integrity-only; main 01e1429db9749aea3f044448633fb287dda585a3

limitations: Engineering-only control; do not merge as scientific evidence or infer mathematical validity.
Review/required-check outcomes must be inspected on this PR at its exact head SHA.
This smoke experiment has no dataset, scientific statistic, or cosmological observation.
